purpose: Engineering migration plan; not public website content.
scope: Restructure the existing repository without redesigning or changing public capabilities.

privateWorkspace: private originals and credentials outside tracked source

invariants: Keep existing public URLs and anchors.
One business feature owns its content, presentation and artwork.
Shared presentation must not import feature-owned business content.
Preserve all archive/database files unchanged.
Keep tools/reference-release.json and build/package/verify entry points in place.
Preserve original image pixels, logo payloads, CSS order and loading behavior.
Source path allowlists must be updated in the same review as moved paths.
Protected legal/reference changes need explicit path/receipt review.
No new backend, API runtime, database or local authentication.
Keep exact vendor Welcome URL and no-referrer behavior.
Preserve one shared Shell, header, footer and design system.
Keep the same GitHub repository, Netlify project and canonical domain.
Merchant access uses https://merchantapp.io/etaildepot/UserAccount/Login with no forwarded visitor input or referrers.
Preserve closed card applications, approved pricing, eligibility and provider limitations.
Preserve the enabled Emails extension and its pinned authenticated POST handler.
Do not alter denied resources, DNS, Identity, database history or unrelated email settings.
Retirement routing remains read only and never reads or forwards submitted bodies.
Use pinned Node and pnpm with one lockfile; no dependency upgrades for this migration.
Publishing source to public GitHub is separate from publishing compiled website content.
Local verification is not authorization to push, merge or deploy.

localWorkReconciliation.handling: The previous working copy is preserved separately. Do not copy it wholesale or include its eight unpublished Developers routes in a structure-only migration.

verificationLimits: Stage 1 performs read-only source, dependency, live route and sitemap verification.
No application source is changed, built or packaged in Stage 1.
Full visual/loading and release verification will run against the changed source in later stages.

stages.name: Baseline and complete migration map
deliverables: Preserve previous work without overwriting it.
Verify the GitHub commit against the published Netlify deployment.
Start a migration branch from the published commit.
Map every published file, dependency, route and protected source.
Separate unpublished additions from the structural migration.

stages.name: Shared foundation and one service pilot
deliverables: Review and selectively port publication safeguards from previous work.
Establish shared layout, brand, UI, site configuration and SEO ownership.
Move one contained service feature, ACH payments, with its content and artwork.
Update all affected imports, source allowlists and checks in the same change.
gate: Preserve existing render output, URLs, loading behavior and vendor handoffs.
Pass affected static, unit, browser, accessibility and build checks.
Compare the pilot and shared header/footer on desktop and mobile.

stages.name: Remaining business features
deliverables: Migrate remaining Services, Home, Use cases, Pricing, Resources and Company in reviewed batches.
Keep current vendor setup and integration guides under Resources.
Reserve public Developers for future Etail developer products; do not silently publish the separate coming-soon feature.
Review legal/reference path changes and receipt updates explicitly.
Relink image generators without changing pixels or reintroducing delayed first paint.
gate: Retain all 3752 public page addresses and stable anchors.
Retain all 3740 sitemap entries and the 12 noindex legal/policy pages.
Compare route output, authored copy, metadata, artwork, interactions and responsive layouts.
Preserve frozen reference data, licence notices and approved legal provisions.

stages.name: Engineering instructions and reviewed history
deliverables: Consolidate current project instructions; distinguish current decisions from old records.
Review stale relative documentation links and update moved file references.
Archive only reviewed public historical records after dependency and sensitivity review.
Keep tools/reference-release.json and build, package and verification entry points stable.
Keep archive/database byte-for-byte unchanged.
Keep contributor workflow separate from public Developers content.
gate: No dangling active tool, CI, configuration or documentation references.
No private working records, original screenshots, secrets or generated review artifacts in public source or the deploy package.
No root build/publish directory, Git deployment workflow, domain or runtime change.

stages.name: Full verification and release preparation
deliverables: Review the exact final diff and verify that structural work did not change approved behavior.
Compare desktop/mobile first access, refresh, anchor navigation, images and menus.
Run pnpm verify:public, pnpm test:seo:production, pnpm package:netlify and pnpm verify:package.
Record package/source identity, remaining hosted checks and a rollback reference.
Prepare the reviewed PR and release notes; obtain applicable publication authorization separately.
gate: Preserve production indexing guards, preview noindex and empty preview sitemap.
Package only the approved website, one edge boundary and the pinned authenticated Emails handler.
After authorized publication, verify the exact deployed commit and hosted routes, headers, cache, sitemap and source-file 404s.
